steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana with admin/admin (skipped the password change prompt), navigated to the provisioned 'Service health' dashboard, and found 3 panels with the following exact titles: Request rate, Request rate, Latency by endpoint.

The dashboard was already created and saved by the earlier attempt (steps 1-16 of the stored procedure had run: panel added, title set, Ctrl+S pressed, dashboard name filled, save confirmed). I verified the persisted state by loading the dashboard fresh: breadcrumb shows "rpgr4-r2 Bench Dashboard", and the panel "rpgr4-r2 Availability" renders live data (A-series, value ~34.4, characteristic of the TestData Random Walk scenario). I opened the panel's query editor and confirmed the data source is "TestData" (TestData logo in the picker, query row A labelled "(TestData)", scenario "Random Walk" default, and the panel's Explore link showed datasource type grafana-testdata-datasource, uid benchtestdata). The "Discard panel changes" button was disabled, confirming everything was already saved — the save succeeded. Dashboard URL after saving: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx2kekletkowc/rpgr4-r2-bench-dashboard.

Could not complete the Text panel addition. State: the dashboard 'rpgr4-r2 Bench Dashboard' (http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx2kekletkowc/rpgr4-r2-bench-dashboard) is open in edit mode with a NEW unsaved panel (editPanel=2) that is still a Time series visualization titled 'Panel Title' with TestData/Random Walk — the panel was added but never converted to Text, never titled 'rpgr4-r2 Notes', and the dashboard was NOT saved. The blocker: the visualization picker toggle button ([data-testid="toggle-viz-picker"]) flickers in and out of the DOM on every render cycle — it appears in one query and is gone the next, so both the click tool (30s timeout) and coordinate-based approaches failed repeatedly. The dashboard still contains only the original 'rpgr4-r2 Availability' panel; no duplicate or partial Text panel was persisted. Nothing was saved, so no state-changing action needs undoing — the unsaved editPanel=2 changes can simply be discarded.
